title: Bandari–Herzog's conjecture on componentwise polymatroidal ideals
statement: Let $S=K[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ be a polynomial ring over a field $K$. A monomial ideal $I\subset S$ is **componentwise polymatroidal** when each component $I_{\langle j\rangle}$ is polymatroidal, where $I_{\langle j\rangle}$ is generated by the degree-$j$ monomials belonging to $I$. **Bandari–Herzog's conjecture.** If $I$ is componentwise polymatroidal, then $I$ has linear quotients. Since polymatroidal ideals have linear quotients, this is a particular case of Jahan–Zheng's conjecture; the source presents it as the conjecture proved positively by the paper.
source_name: Antonino Ficarra, “Shellability of Componentwise Discrete Polymatroids”, arXiv:2312.13006 (2023).
